description: Analyse décisionnelle — Résultats électoraux IDF 2022, modèles ML et projections 2025-2027

panels.title: Communes Macron gagnant (GB post-T1)
panels.description: Nombre de communes IDF prédites Macron par le modèle Gradient Boosting post-T1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Communes Macron" FROM gold.model_predictions WHERE model_name = 'gradient_boosting' AND feature_set = 'post_t1' AND target = 'regression_macron' AND prediction = '0'

panels.title: Communes Le Pen gagnant (GB post-T1)
panels.description: Nombre de communes IDF prédites Le Pen par le modèle Gradient Boosting post-T1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Communes Le Pen" FROM gold.model_predictions WHERE model_name = 'gradient_boosting' AND feature_set = 'post_t1' AND target = 'regression_macron' AND prediction = '1'

panels.title: R² Score — GB post-T1 (set de test)
panels.description: R² du modèle GB post-T1 sur le set de test (régression % Macron T2, affiché ×100).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(metric_value::numeric * 100, 1) AS "R² (×100)" FROM gold.latest_model_metrics WHERE model_name = 'gradient_boosting' AND feature_set = 'post_t1' AND target = 'regression_macron' AND metric_name = 'test_r2' LIMIT 1

panels.title: Quality Gates réussis
panels.description: Nombre de vérifications qualité ETL ayant réussi sur le dernier run

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Checks OK" FROM audit.quality_checks WHERE passed = true AND run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM audit.quality_checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Prédictions Macron vs Le Pen par département (GB post-T1)
panels.description: Nombre de communes par département prédites pour chaque candidat. Source : gold.model_predictions

targets.rawSql: SELECT code_departement AS "Département", SUM(CASE WHEN prediction = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Macron", SUM(CASE WHEN prediction = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Le Pen" FROM gold.model_predictions WHERE model_name = 'gradient_boosting' AND feature_set = 'post_t1' AND target = 'regression_macron' GROUP BY code_departement ORDER BY code_departement

panels.title: Top 20 communes — probabilité Le Pen la plus élevée
panels.description: Communes où le modèle prédit Le Pen avec la plus forte probabilité. Source : gold.model_predictions

targets.rawSql: SELECT libelle_commune AS "Commune", code_departement AS "Dept", ROUND(probability::numeric * 100, 1) AS "Proba Le Pen (%)", CASE WHEN correct = 1 THEN '✓' ELSE '✗' END AS "Correct ?" FROM gold.model_predictions WHERE model_name = 'gradient_boosting' AND feature_set = 'post_t1' AND target = 'regression_macron' AND prediction::text = '1' ORDER BY probability DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Métriques comparatives des modèles ML
panels.description: R², MAE, RMSE pour tous les modèles entraînés (régression % Macron T2). Source : gold.latest_model_metrics

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_name AS "Modèle", feature_set AS "Feature set", metric_name AS "Métrique", ROUND(metric_value::numeric, 4) AS "Valeur" FROM gold.latest_model_metrics WHERE target = 'regression_macron' AND metric_name IN ('test_r2', 'test_mae', 'test_rmse') ORDER BY model_name, feature_set, metric_name

panels.title: Revenu médian par département (dim_commune — datamart)
panels.description: Revenu médian moyen par département IDF. Indicateur corrélé positivement avec le vote Macron (r=+0.67). Source : datamart.dim_commune

targets.rawSql: SELECT code_departement AS "Département", ROUND(AVG(revenu_median)::numeric, 0) AS "Revenu médian (€)", ROUND(AVG(taux_chomage)::numeric, 1) AS "Taux chômage (%)" FROM datamart.dim_commune WHERE revenu_median IS NOT NULL GROUP BY code_departement ORDER BY code_departement

panels.title: ★ Résultats T2 2022 par département — DATAMART (fait_resultats_electoraux)
panels.description: Pourcentage moyen des voix Macron / Le Pen par département IDF au T2 2022. Source : datamart.fait_resultats_electoraux JOIN dim_commune JOIN dim_candidat JOIN dim_temps

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.code_departement AS "Département", cand.nom_candidat AS "Candidat", ROUND(AVG(f.pct_voix)::numeric, 1) AS "% moyen des voix" FROM datamart.fait_resultats_electoraux f JOIN datamart.dim_commune c ON f.sk_commune = c.sk_commune JOIN datamart.dim_candidat cand ON f.sk_candidat = cand.sk_candidat JOIN datamart.dim_temps t ON f.sk_temps = t.sk_temps WHERE t.annee = 2022 AND t.tour = 2 AND cand.nom_candidat IN ('Emmanuel Macron', 'Marine Le Pen') GROUP BY c.code_departement, cand.nom_candidat ORDER BY c.code_departement, cand.nom_candidat

panels.title: ★ Historique électoraux 2012–2022 — DATAMART (fait_resultats_electoraux)
panels.description: Évolution des résultats des candidats principaux sur 3 élections (2012 T2, 2017 T2, 2022 T2). Source : datamart.fait_resultats_electoraux JOIN dim_candidat JOIN dim_temps

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.label AS "Scrutin", cand.nom_candidat AS "Candidat", cand.orientation AS "Orientation", ROUND(AVG(f.pct_voix)::numeric, 1) AS "% moyen IDF", COUNT(DISTINCT f.sk_commune) AS "Nb communes" FROM datamart.fait_resultats_electoraux f JOIN datamart.dim_candidat cand ON f.sk_candidat = cand.sk_candidat JOIN datamart.dim_temps t ON f.sk_temps = t.sk_temps WHERE t.tour = 2 AND cand.nom_candidat IN ('Emmanuel Macron','Marine Le Pen','François Hollande','Nicolas Sarkozy') GROUP BY t.label, t.annee, t.tour, cand.nom_candidat, cand.orientation ORDER BY t.annee, t.tour, cand.nom_candidat

panels.title: Comparaison R² des modèles ML (tous les modèles)
panels.description: R² sur le set de test (20 %) pour chaque modèle entraîné (régression % Macron T2, affiché ×100). Source : gold.latest_model_metrics

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(model_name, ' / ', feature_set) AS "Modèle", ROUND(metric_value::numeric * 100, 1) AS "R² (×100)" FROM gold.latest_model_metrics WHERE target = 'regression_macron' AND metric_name = 'test_r2' ORDER BY metric_value DESC

panels.title: Audit qualité ETL — quality gates (dernier run)
panels.description: Résultats des vérifications automatiques sur le dataset gold. Source : audit.quality_checks

targets.rawSql: SELECT check_name AS "Vérification", CASE WHEN passed THEN '✅ OK' ELSE '❌ FAIL' END AS "Statut", COALESCE(details, '—') AS "Détails", TO_CHAR(checked_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "Heure" FROM audit.quality_checks WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM audit.quality_checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY passed, check_name

title: Electio-Analytics — Elections IDF 2022
